verses.en: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
verses.fr: Ce qui était dès le commencement, ce que nous avons entendu, ce que nous avons vu de nos yeux, ce que nous avons contemplé et que nos mains ont touché, concernant la parole de vie, -
verses.am: ስለ ሕይወት ቃል ከመጀመሪያው የነበረውንና የሰማነውን በዓይኖቻችንም ያየነውን የተመለከትነውንም እጆቻችንም የዳሰሱትን እናወራለን፤

verses.en: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
verses.fr: car la vie a été manifestée, et nous l''avons vue et nous lui rendons témoignage, et nous vous annonçons la vie éternelle, qui était auprès du Père et qui nous a été manifestée, -
verses.am: ሕይወትም ተገለጠ አይተንማል እንመሰክርማለን፥ ከአብ ዘንድ የነበረውንም ለእኛም የተገለጠውን የዘላለምን ሕይወት እናወራላችኋለን፤

verses.en: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: ce que nous avons vu et entendu, nous vous l''annonçons, à vous aussi, afin que vous aussi vous soyez en communion avec nous. Or, notre communion est avec le Père et avec son Fils Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: እናንተ ደግሞ ከእኛ ጋር ኅብረት እንዲኖራችሁ ያየነውንና የሰማነውን ለእናንተ ደግሞ እናወራላችኋለን። ኅብረታችንም ከአባት ጋር ከልጁም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጋር ነው።

verses.en: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
verses.fr: Et nous écrivons ces choses, afin que notre joie soit parfaite.
verses.am: ደስታችሁም እንዲፈጸም ይህን እንጽፍላችኋለን።

verses.en: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.fr: La nouvelle que nous avons apprise de lui, et que nous vous annonçons, c''est que Dieu est lumière, et qu''il n''y a point en lui de ténèbres.
verses.am: ከእርሱም የሰማናት ለእናንተም የምናወራላችሁ መልእክት። እግዚአብሔር ብርሃን ነው ጨለማም በእርሱ ዘንድ ከቶ የለም የምትል ይህች ናት።

verses.en: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
verses.fr: Si nous disons que nous sommes en communion avec lui, et que nous marchions dans les ténèbres, nous mentons, et nous ne pratiquons pas la vérité.
verses.am: ከእርሱ ጋር ኅብረት አለን ብንል በጨለማም ብንመላለስ እንዋሻለን እውነትንም አናደርግም፤

verses.en: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
verses.fr: Mais si nous marchons dans la lumière, comme il est lui-même dans la lumière, nous sommes mutuellement en communion, et le sang de Jésus son Fils nous purifie de tout péché.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እርሱ በብርሃን እንዳለ በብርሃን ብንመላለስ ለእያንዳንዳችን ኅብረት አለን፥ የልጁም የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ደም ከኃጢአት ሁሉ ያነጻናል።

verses.en: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.fr: Si nous disons que nous n''avons pas de péché, nous nous séduisons nous-mêmes, et la vérité n''est point en nous.
verses.am: ኃጢአት የለብንም ብንል ራሳችንን እናስታለን፥ እውነትም በእኛ ውስጥ የለም።

verses.en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.fr: Si nous confessons nos péchés, il est fidèle et juste pour nous les pardonner, et pour nous purifier de toute iniquité.
verses.am: በኃጢአታችን ብንናዘዝ ኃጢአታችንን ይቅር ሊለን ከዓመፃም ሁሉ ሊያነጻን የታመነና ጻድቅ ነው።

verses.en: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.fr: Si nous disons que nous n''avons pas péché, nous le faisons menteur, et sa parole n''est point en nous.
verses.am: ኃጢአትን አላደረግንም ብንል ሐሰተኛ እናደርገዋለን ቃሉም በእኛ ውስጥ የለም።

verses.en: My little children, these things write I unto you, that ye sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous:
verses.fr: Mes petits enfants, je vous écris ces choses, afin que vous ne péchiez point. Et si quelqu''un a péché, nous avons un avocat auprès du Père, Jésus-Christ le juste.
verses.am: ልጆቼ ሆይ፥ ኃጢአትን እንዳታደርጉ ይህን እጽፍላችኋለሁ። ማንም ኃጢአትን ቢያደርግ ከአብ ዘንድ ጠበቃ አለን እርሱም ጻድቅ የሆነ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ነው።

verses.en: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
verses.fr: Il est lui-même une victime expiatoire pour nos péchés, non seulement pour les nôtres, mais aussi pour ceux du monde entier.
verses.am: እርሱም የኃጢአታችን ማስተስሪያ ነው፥ ለኃጢአታችንም ብቻ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ለዓለሙ ሁሉ ኃጢአት እንጂ።

verses.en: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
verses.fr: Si nous gardons ses commandements, par là nous savons que nous l''avons connu.
verses.am: ትእዛዛቱንም ብንጠብቅ በዚህ እንዳወቅነው እናውቃለን።

verses.en: He that saith, I know him, and keepeth not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
verses.fr: Celui qui dit: Je l''ai connu, et qui ne garde pas ses commandements, est un menteur, et la vérité n''est point en lui.
verses.am: አውቄዋለሁ የሚል ትእዛዛቱንም የማይጠብቅ ውሸተኛ ነው እውነትም በእርሱ ውስጥ የለም።

verses.en: But whoso keepeth his word, in him verily is the love of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
verses.fr: Mais celui qui garde sa parole, l''amour de Dieu est véritablement parfait en lui: par là nous savons que nous sommes en lui.
verses.am: ቃሉን ግን የሚጠብቅ ሁሉ በእርሱ የእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር በእውነት ተፈጽሞአል። በእርሱ እንዳለን በዚህ እናውቃለን፤

verses.en: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
verses.fr: Celui qui dit qu''il demeure en lui doit marcher aussi comme il a marché lui-même.
verses.am: በእርሱ እኖራለሁ የሚል እርሱ እንደ ተመላለሰ ራሱ ደግሞ ሊመላለስ ይገባዋል።

verses.en: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which ye had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which ye have heard from the beginning.
verses.fr: Bien-aimés, ce n''est pas un commandement nouveau que je vous écris, mais un commandement ancien que vous avez eu dès le commencement; ce commandement ancien, c''est la parole que vous avez entendue.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ከመጀመሪያ የነበረቻችሁ አሮጌ ትእዛዝ እንጂ የምጽፍላችሁ አዲስ ትእዛዝ አይደለችም፤ አሮጌይቱ ትእዛዝ የሰማችኋት ቃል ናት።

verses.en: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
verses.fr: Toutefois, c''est un commandement nouveau que je vous écris, ce qui est vrai en lui et en vous, car les ténèbres se dissipent et la lumière véritable paraît déjà.
verses.am: ዳግመኛ አዲስ ትእዛዝን እጽፍላችኋለሁ፥ ይህም ነገር በእርሱ በእናንተም እውነተኛ ነው፤ ጨለማው ያልፋልና እውነተኛውም ብርሃን አሁን ይበራል።

verses.en: He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.
verses.fr: Celui qui dit qu''il est dans la lumière, et qui hait son frère, est encore dans les ténèbres.
verses.am: በብርሃን አለሁ የሚል ወንድሙንም የሚጠላ እስከ አሁን በጨለማ አለ።

verses.en: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
verses.fr: Celui qui aime son frère demeure dans la lumière, et aucune occasion de chute n''est en lui.
verses.am: ወንድሙንም የሚወድ በብርሃን ይኖራል ማሰናከያም የለበትም፤

verses.en: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.
verses.fr: Mais celui qui hait son frère est dans les ténèbres, il marche dans les ténèbres, et il ne sait où il va, parce que les ténèbres ont aveuglé ses yeux.
verses.am: ወንድሙን የሚጠላ ግን በጨለማ አለ፥ በጨለማም ይመላለሳል፥ የሚሄድበትንም አያውቅም፥ ጨለማው ዓይኖቹን አሳውሮታልና።

verses.en: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.
verses.fr: Je vous écris, petits enfants, parce que vos péchés vous sont pardonnés à cause de son nom.
verses.am: ልጆች ሆይ፥ ኃጢአታችሁ ስለ ስሙ ተሰርዮላችኋልና እጽፍላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: I write unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because ye have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because ye have known the Father.
verses.fr: Je vous écris, pères, parce que vous avez connu celui qui est dès le commencement. Je vous écris, jeunes gens, parce que vous avez vaincu le malin. Je vous ai écrit, petits enfants, parce que vous avez connu le Père.
verses.am: አባቶች ሆይ፥ ከመጀመሪያ የነበረውን አውቃችኋልና እጽፍላችኋለሁ። ጎበዞች ሆይ፥ ክፉውን አሸንፋችኋልና እጽፍላችኋለሁ። ልጆች ሆይ፥ አብን አውቃችኋልና እጽፍላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: I have written unto you, fathers, because ye have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because ye are strong, and the word of God abideth in you, and ye have overcome the wicked one.
verses.fr: Je vous ai écrit, pères, parce que vous avez connu celui qui est dès le commencement. Je vous ai écrit, jeunes gens, parce que vous êtes forts, et que la parole de Dieu demeure en vous, et que vous avez vaincu le malin.
verses.am: አባቶች ሆይ፥ ከመጀመሪያ የነበረውን አውቃችኋልና እጽፍላችኋለሁ። ጐበዞች ሆይ፥ ብርቱዎች ስለ ሆናችሁ የእግዚአብሔርም ቃል በእናንተ ስለሚኖር ክፉውንም ስለ አሸነፋችሁ እጽፍላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.fr: N''aimez point le monde, ni les choses qui sont dans le monde. Si quelqu''un aime le monde, l''amour du Père n''est point en lui;
verses.am: ዓለሙም ምኞቱም ያልፋሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ ግን ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
verses.fr: car tout ce qui est dans le monde, la convoitise de la chair, la convoitise des yeux, et l''orgueil de la vie, ne vient point du Père, mais vient du monde.
verses.am: ዓለሙም ምኞቱም ያልፋሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ የሚያደርግ ግን ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

verses.en: And the world passeth away, and the lust thereof: but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever.
verses.fr: Et le monde passe, et sa convoitise aussi; mais celui qui fait la volonté de Dieu demeure éternellement.
verses.am: ልጆች ሆይ፥ መጨረሻው ሰዓት ነው፥ የክርስቶስም ተቃዋሚ ይመጣ ዘንድ እንደ ሰማችሁ አሁን እንኳ ብዙዎች የክርስቶስ ተቃዋሚዎች ተነሥተዋል፤ ስለዚህም መጨረሻው ሰዓት እንደ ሆነ እናውቃለን።

verses.en: Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
verses.fr: Petits enfants, c''est la dernière heure, et comme vous avez appris qu''un antéchrist vient, il y a maintenant plusieurs antéchrists: par là nous connaissons que c''est la dernière heure.
verses.am: ከእኛ ዘንድ ወጡ፥ ዳሩ ግን ከእኛ ወገን አልነበሩም፤ ከእኛ ወገንስ ቢሆኑ ከእኛ ጋር ጸንተው በኖሩ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን ሁሉ ከእኛ ወገን እንዳልሆኑ ይገለጡ ዘንድ ወጡ።

verses.en: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
verses.fr: Ils sont sortis du milieu de nous, mais ils n''étaient pas des nôtres; car s''ils eussent été des nôtres, ils seraient demeurés avec nous, mais cela est arrivé afin qu''il fût manifeste que tous ne sont pas des nôtres.
verses.am: እናንተም ከቅዱሱ ቅባት ተቀብላችኋል፥ ሁሉንም ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.
verses.fr: Pour vous, vous avez reçu l''onction de la part de celui qui est saint, et vous avez tous de la connaissance.
verses.am: እውነትን የምታውቁ ስለ ሆናችሁ፥ ውሸትም ሁሉ ከእውነት እንዳልሆነ ስለምታውቁ እንጂ እውነትን ስለማታውቁ አልጽፍላችሁም።

verses.en: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth, but because ye know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
verses.fr: Je vous ai écrit, non que vous ne connaissiez pas la vérité, mais parce que vous la connaissez, et parce qu''aucun mensonge ne vient de la vérité.
verses.am: ክርስቶስ አይደለም ብሎ ኢየሱስን ከሚክድ በቀር ውሸተኛው ማን ነው? አብንና ወልድን የሚክድ ይህ የክርስቶስ ተቃዋሚ ነው።

verses.en: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
verses.fr: Qui est menteur, sinon celui qui nie que Jésus est le Christ? Celui-là est l''antéchrist, qui nie le Père et le Fils.
verses.am: ወልድን የሚክድ ሁሉ አብ እንኳ የለውም፤ በወልድ የሚታመን አብ ደግሞ አለው።

verses.en: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same hath not the Father: he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also.
verses.fr: Quiconque nie le Fils n''a pas non plus le Père; quiconque confesse le Fils a aussi le Père.
verses.am: እናንተስ ከመጀመሪያ የሰማችሁት በእናንተ ጸንቶ ይኑር። ከመጀመሪያ የሰማችሁት በእናንተ ቢኖር፥ እናንተ ደግሞ በወልድና በአብ ትኖራላችሁ።

verses.en: Let that therefore abide in you, which ye have heard from the beginning. If that which ye have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, ye also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
verses.fr: Que ce que vous avez entendu dès le commencement demeure en vous. Si ce que vous avez entendu dès le commencement demeure en vous, vous demeurerez aussi dans le Fils et dans le Père.
verses.am: እርሱም የሰጠን ተስፋ ይህ የዘላለም ሕይወት ነው።

verses.en: And this is the promise that he hath promised us, even eternal life.
verses.fr: Et la promesse qu''il nous a faite, c''est la vie éternelle.
verses.am: ስለሚያስቱአችሁ ሰዎች ይህን ጽፌላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
verses.fr: Je vous ai écrit ces choses au sujet de ceux qui vous égarent.
verses.am: እናንተስ ከእርሱ የተቀበላችሁት ቅባት በእናንተ ይኖራል፥ ማንም ሊያስተምራችሁ አያስፈልጋችሁም፤ ነገር ግን የእርሱ ቅባት ስለ ሁሉ እንደሚያስተምራችሁ፥ እውነተኛም እንደ ሆነ ውሸትም እንዳልሆነ፥ እናንተንም እንዳስተማራችሁ፥ በእርሱ ኑሩ።

verses.en: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you, and ye need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it hath taught you, ye shall abide in him.
verses.fr: Pour vous, l''onction que vous avez reçue de lui demeure en vous, et vous n''avez pas besoin qu''on vous enseigne; mais comme son onction vous enseigne toutes choses, et qu''elle est véritable et qu''elle n''est point un mensonge, demeurez en lui selon les enseignements qu''elle vous a donnés.
verses.am: አሁንም፥ ልጆች ሆይ፥ በሚገለጥበት ጊዜ እምነት እንዲሆንልን በመምጣቱም በእርሱ ፊት እንዳናፍር በእርሱ ኑሩ።

verses.en: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
verses.fr: Et maintenant, petits enfants, demeurez en lui, afin que, lorsqu''il paraîtra, nous ayons de l''assurance, et qu''à son avènement nous ne soyons pas confus et éloignés de lui.
verses.am: ጻድቅ እንደ ሆነ ካወቃችሁ ጽድቅን የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ከእርሱ እንደ ተወለደ እወቁ።

verses.en: If ye know that he is righteous, ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him.
verses.fr: Si vous savez qu''il est juste, reconnaissez que quiconque pratique la justice est né de lui.
verses.am: ጻድቅ እንደ ሆነ ካወቃችሁ ጽድቅን የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ከእርሱ እንደ ተወለደ እወቁ።

verses.en: Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.
verses.fr: Voyez quel amour le Père nous a témoigné, pour que nous soyons appelés enfants de Dieu! Et nous le sommes. Si le monde ne nous connaît pas, c''est qu''il ne l''a pas connu.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ተብለን ልንጠራ አብ እንዴት ያለውን ፍቅር እንደ ሰጠን እዩ፥ እንዲሁም ነን። ስለዚህ ምክንያት ዓለም እርሱን ስላላወቀው እኛን አያውቀንም።

verses.en: Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it doth not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
verses.fr: Bien-aimés, nous sommes maintenant enfants de Dieu, et ce que nous serons n''a pas encore été manifesté; mais nous savons que, lorsque cela sera manifesté, nous serons semblables à lui, parce que nous le verrons tel qu''il est.
verses.am: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ አሁን የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች ነን፥ ምንም እንደምንሆን ገና አልተገለጠም። ዳሩ ግን ቢገለጥ እርሱ እንዳለ እናየዋለንና እርሱን እንድንመስል እናውቃለን።

verses.en: And every man that hath this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
verses.fr: Quiconque a cette espérance en lui se purifie, comme lui-même est pur.
verses.am: በእርሱም ይህን ተስፋ የሚያደርግ ሁሉ እርሱ ንጹሕ እንደ ሆነ ራሱን ያነጻል።

verses.en: Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.
verses.fr: Quiconque pèche transgresse la loi, et le péché est la transgression de la loi.
verses.am: ኃጢአትን የሚያደርግ ሁሉ ዓመፅን ደግሞ ያደርጋል፥ ኃጢአትም ዓመፅ ነው።

verses.en: And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.
verses.fr: Or, vous le savez, Jésus a paru pour ôter les péchés, et il n''y a point en lui de péché.
verses.am: እርሱም ኃጢአትን ሊያስወግድ እንደ ተገለጠ ታውቃላችሁ፥ በእርሱም ኃጢአት የለም።

verses.en: Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not: whosoever sinneth hath not seen him, neither known him.
verses.fr: Quiconque demeure en lui ne pèche point; quiconque pèche ne l''a pas vu, et ne l''a pas connu.
verses.am: በእርሱ የሚኖር ሁሉ ኃጢአትን አያደርግም፤ ኃጢአትን የሚያደርግ ሁሉ አላየውም አላወቀውምም።

verses.en: Little children, let no man deceive you: he that doeth righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
verses.fr: Petits enfants, que personne ne vous séduise. Celui qui pratique la justice est juste, comme lui-même est juste.
verses.am: ልጆች ሆይ፥ ማንም አያስታችሁ፤ እርሱ ጻድቅ እንደ ሆነ ጽድቅን የሚያደርግ ጻድቅ ነው።

verses.en: He that committeth sin is of the devil; for the devil sinneth from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil.
verses.fr: Celui qui pèche est du diable, car le diable pèche dès le commencement. Le Fils de Dieu a paru afin de détruire les oeuvres du diable.
verses.am: ኃጢአትን የሚያደርግ ከዲያብሎስ ነው፥ ዲያብሎስ ከመጀመሪያ ኃጢአትን ያደርጋልና።

verses.en: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin; for his seed remaineth in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God.
verses.fr: Quiconque est né de Dieu ne pratique pas le péché, parce que la semence de Dieu demeure en lui; et il ne peut pécher, parce qu''il est né de Dieu.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የዲያብሎስን ሥራ እንዲያፈርስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ተገለጠ። ከእግዚአብሔር የተወለደ ሁሉ ኃጢአትን አያደርግም፥ ዘሩ በእርሱ ይኖራልና፤ ከእግዚአብሔርም ተወልዶአልና ኃጢአትን ሊያደርግ አይችልም።

verses.en: In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loveth not his brother.
verses.fr: C''est par là que se font reconnaître les enfants de Dieu et les enfants du diable. Quiconque ne pratique pas la justice n''est pas de Dieu, non plus que celui qui n''aime pas son frère.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ልጆችና የዲያብሎስ ልጆች በዚህ የተገለጡ ናቸው፤ ጽድቅን የማያደርግና ወንድሙን የማይወድ ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር አይደለም።

verses.en: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
verses.fr: Car ce qui vous a été annoncé et ce que vous avez entendu dès le commencement, c''est que nous devons nous aimer les uns les autres,
verses.am: ከመጀመሪያ የሰማችኋት መልእክት። እርስ በርሳችን እንዋደድ የምትል ይህች ናትና፤

verses.en: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.
verses.fr: et ne pas ressembler à Caïn, qui était du malin, et qui tua son frère. Et pourquoi le tua-t-il? parce que ses oeuvres étaient mauvaises, et que celles de son frère étaient justes.
verses.am: ከክፉው እንደ ነበረ ወንድሙንም እንደ ገደለ እንደ ቃየል አይደለም፤ ስለ ምንስ ገደለው? የገዛ ሥራው ክፉ፥ የወንድሙም ሥራ ጽድቅ ስለ ነበረ ነው።

verses.en: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
verses.fr: Ne vous étonnez pas, frères, si le monde vous hait.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ዓለም ቢጠላችሁ አትደነቁ።

verses.en: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.
verses.fr: Nous savons que nous sommes passés de la mort à la vie, parce que nous aimons les frères. Celui qui n''aime pas demeure dans la mort.
verses.am: እኛ ወንድሞችን የምንወድ ስለ ሆንን ከሞት ወደ ሕይወት እንደ ተሻገርን እናውቃለን፤ ወንድሙን የማይወድ በሞት ይኖራል።

verses.en: Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.
verses.fr: Quiconque hait son frère est un meurtrier, et vous savez qu''aucun meurtrier n''a la vie éternelle demeurant en lui.
verses.am: ወንድሙን የሚጠላ ሁሉ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፥ ነፍሰ ገዳይም የሆነ ሁሉ የዘላለም ሕይወት በእርሱ እንዳይኖር ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: Hereby perceive we the love of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
verses.fr: Nous avons connu l''amour, en ce qu''il a donné sa vie pour nous; nous aussi, nous devons donner notre vie pour les frères.
verses.am: እርሱ ስለ እኛ ነፍሱን አሳልፎ ሰጥቶአልና በዚህ ፍቅርን አውቀናል፤ እኛም ስለ ወንድሞቻችን ነፍሳችንን አሳልፈን እንድንሰጥ ይገባናል።

verses.en: But whoso hath this world's good, and seeth his brother have need, and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwelleth the love of God in him?
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un possède les biens du monde, et que, voyant son frère dans le besoin, il lui ferme ses entrailles, comment l''amour de Dieu demeure-t-il en lui?
verses.am: ነገር ግን የዚህ ዓለም ገንዘብ ያለው፥ ወንድሙም የሚያስፈልገው ሲያጣ አይቶ ያልራራለት ማንም ቢሆን፥ የእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር በእርሱ እንዴት ይኖራል?

verses.en: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
verses.fr: Petits enfants, n''aimons pas en paroles et avec la langue, mais en actions et avec vérité.
verses.am: ልጆቼ ሆይ፥ በሥራና በእውነት እንጂ በቃልና በአንደበት አንዋደድ።

verses.en: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
verses.fr: Par là nous connaîtrons que nous sommes de la vérité, et nous rassurerons nos coeurs devant lui;
verses.am: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ልባችንስ ባይፈርድብን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ድፍረት አለን፥

verses.en: For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knoweth all things.
verses.fr: car si notre coeur nous condamne, Dieu est plus grand que notre coeur, et il connaît toutes choses.
verses.am: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ልባችንስ ባይፈርድብን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ድፍረት አለን፥

verses.en: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God.
verses.fr: Bien-aimés, si notre coeur ne nous condamne pas, nous avons de l''assurance devant Dieu.
verses.am: ትእዛዙንም የምንጠብቅና በፊቱ ደስ የሚያሰኘውን የምናደርግ ስለሆንን የምንለምነውን ሁሉ ከእርሱ እናገኛለን።

verses.en: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
verses.fr: Quoi que ce soit que nous demandions, nous le recevons de lui, parce que nous gardons ses commandements et que nous faisons ce qui lui est agréable.
verses.am: ትእዛዚቱም ይህች ናት፥ በልጁ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም እናምን ዘንድ፥ ትእዛዝንም እንደ ሰጠን እርስ በርሳችን እንዋደድ ዘንድ።

verses.en: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
verses.fr: Et c''est ici son commandement: que nous croyions au nom de son Fils Jésus-Christ, et que nous nous aimions les uns les autres, selon le commandement qu''il nous a donné.
verses.am: ትእዛዙንም የሚጠብቅ በእርሱ ይኖራል እርሱም ይኖርበታል፤ በዚህም በእኛ እንዲኖር ከሰጠን ከመንፈሱ እናውቃለን።

verses.en: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abideth in us, by the Spirit which he hath given us.
verses.fr: Celui qui garde ses commandements demeure en Dieu, et Dieu en lui; et nous connaissons qu''il demeure en nous par l''Esprit qu''il nous a donné.
verses.am: ትእዛዙንም የሚጠብቅ በእርሱ ይኖራል እርሱም ይኖርበታል፤ በዚህም በእኛ እንዲኖር ከሰጠን ከመንፈሱ እናውቃለን።

verses.en: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
verses.fr: Bien-aimés, n''ajoutez pas foi à tout esprit; mais éprouvez les esprits, pour savoir s''ils sont de Dieu, car plusieurs faux prophètes sont venus dans le monde.
verses.am: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ መንፈስን ሁሉ አትመኑ፥ ነገር ግን መናፍስት ከእግዚአብሔር ሆነው እንደ ሆነ መርምሩ፤ ብዙዎች ሐሰተኞች ነቢያት ወደ ዓለም ወጥተዋልና።

verses.en: Hereby know ye the Spirit of God: Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God:
verses.fr: Reconnaissez à ceci l''Esprit de Dieu: tout esprit qui confesse Jésus-Christ venu en chair est de Dieu;
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን መንፈስ በዚህ ታውቃላችሁ፤ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በሥጋ እንደ መጣ የሚታመን መንፈስ ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ነው፥

verses.en: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
verses.fr: et tout esprit qui ne confesse pas Jésus n''est pas de Dieu, c''est celui de l''antéchrist, dont vous avez appris la venue, et qui maintenant est déjà dans le monde.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም በሥጋ እንደ መጣ የማይታመን መንፈስ ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር አይደለም፤ ይህም የክርስቶስ ተቃዋሚው መንፈስ ነው፤ ይህም እንዲመጣ ሰምታችኋል፥ አሁንም እንኳ በዓለም አለ።

verses.en: Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
verses.fr: Vous, petits enfants, vous êtes de Dieu, et vous les avez vaincus, parce que celui qui est en vous est plus grand que celui qui est dans le monde.
verses.am: ልጆች ሆይ፥ እናንተ ከእግዚአብሔር ናችሁ አሸንፋችኋቸውማል፥ በዓለም ካለው ይልቅ በእናንተ ያለው ታላቅ ነውና።

verses.en: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world heareth them.
verses.fr: Eux, ils sont du monde; c''est pourquoi ils parlent d''après le monde, et le monde les écoute.
verses.am: እነርሱ ከዓለም ናቸው፤ ስለዚህ ከዓለም የሆነውን ይናገራሉ ዓለሙም ይሰማቸዋል።

verses.en: We are of God: he that knoweth God heareth us; he that is not of God heareth not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
verses.fr: Nous, nous sommes de Dieu; celui qui connaît Dieu nous écoute; celui qui n''est pas de Dieu ne nous écoute pas: c''est par là que nous connaissons l''esprit de la vérité et l''esprit de l''erreur.
verses.am: እኛ ከእግዚአብሔር ነን፤ እግዚአብሔርን የሚያውቅ ይሰማናል፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ያልሆነ አይሰማንም። የእውነትን መንፈስና የስሕተትን መንፈስ በዚህ እናውቃለን።

verses.en: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God; and every one that loveth is born of God, and knoweth God.
verses.fr: Bien-aimés, aimons nous les uns les autres; car l''amour est de Dieu, et quiconque aime est né de Dieu et connaît Dieu.
verses.am: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ፍቅር ከእግዚአብሔር ስለ ሆነ፥ የሚወደውም ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ስለ ተወለደ እግዚአብሔርንም ስለሚያውቅ፥ እርስ በርሳችን እንዋደድ።

verses.en: He that loveth not knoweth not God; for God is love.
verses.fr: Celui qui n''aime pas n''a pas connu Dieu, car Dieu est amour.
verses.am: ፍቅር የሌለው እግዚአብሔርን አያውቅም፥ እግዚአብሔር ፍቅር ነውና።

verses.en: In this was manifested the love of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
verses.fr: L''amour de Dieu a été manifesté envers nous en ce que Dieu a envoyé son Fils unique dans le monde, afin que nous vivions par lui.
verses.am: በዚህ የእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር በእኛ ዘንድ ተገለጠ፥ በእርሱ በኩል በሕይወት እንኖር ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አንድ ልጁን ወደ ዓለም ልኮታልና።

verses.en: Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
verses.fr: Et cet amour consiste, non point en ce que nous avons aimé Dieu, mais en ce qu''il nous a aimés et a envoyé son Fils comme victime expiatoire pour nos péchés.
verses.am: ፍቅርም እንደዚህ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር እርሱ ራሱ እንደ ወደደን ስለ ኃጢአታችንም ማስተስሪያ ይሆን ዘንድ ልጁን እንደ ላከ እንጂ እኛ እግዚአብሔርን እንደ ወደድነው አይደለም።

verses.en: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
verses.fr: Bien-aimés, si Dieu nous a ainsi aimés, nous devons aussi nous aimer les uns les autres.
verses.am: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ አድርጎ ከወደደን እኛ ደግሞ እርስ በርሳችን ልንዋደድ ይገባናል።

verses.en: No man hath seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwelleth in us, and his love is perfected in us.
verses.fr: Personne n''a jamais vu Dieu; si nous nous aimons les uns les autres, Dieu demeure en nous, et son amour est parfait en nous.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ማንም ከቶ አላየውም፤ እርስ በርሳችን ብንዋደድ እግዚአብሔር በእኛ ይኖራል ፍቅሩም በእኛ ፍጹም ሆኖአል።

verses.en: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he hath given us of his Spirit.
verses.fr: Nous connaissons que nous demeurons en lui, et qu''il demeure en nous, en ce qu''il nous a donné de son Esprit.
verses.am: ከመንፈሱ ስለ ሰጠን፥ በእርሱ እንድንኖር እርሱም በእኛ እንዲኖር በዚህ እናውቃለን።

verses.en: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
verses.fr: Et nous, nous avons vu et nous attestons que le Père a envoyé le Fils comme Sauveur du monde.
verses.am: እኛም አይተናል አባትም ልጁን የዓለም መድኃኒት ሊሆን እንደ ላከው እንመሰክራለን።

verses.en: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwelleth in him, and he in God.
verses.fr: Celui qui confessera que Jésus est le Fils de Dieu, Dieu demeure en lui, et lui en Dieu.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆነ በሚታመን ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር በእርሱ ይኖራል እርሱም በእግዚአብሔር ይኖራል።

verses.en: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us. God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him.
verses.fr: Et nous, nous avons connu l''amour que Dieu a pour nous, et nous y avons cru. Dieu est amour; et celui qui demeure dans l''amour demeure en Dieu, et Dieu demeure en lui.
verses.am: እኛም እግዚአብሔር ለእኛ ያለውን ፍቅር አውቀናል አምነንማል። እግዚአብሔር ፍቅር ነው፥ በፍቅርም የሚኖር በእግዚአብሔር ይኖራል እግዚአብሔርም በእርሱ ይኖራል።

verses.en: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
verses.fr: Tel il est, tels nous sommes aussi dans ce monde: c''est en cela que l''amour est parfait en nous, afin que nous ayons de l''assurance au jour du jugement.
verses.am: በፍርድ ቀን ድፍረት ይሆንልን ዘንድ ፍቅር በዚህ ከእኛ ጋር ተፈጽሞአል፤ እርሱ እንዳለ እኛ ደግሞ እንዲሁ በዚህ ዓለም ነንና።

verses.en: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear: because fear hath torment. He that feareth is not made perfect in love.
verses.fr: La crainte n''est pas dans l''amour, mais l''amour parfait bannit la crainte; car la crainte suppose un châtiment, et celui qui craint n''est pas parfait dans l''amour.
verses.am: ፍጹም ፍቅር ፍርሃትን አውጥቶ ይጥላል እንጂ በፍቅር ፍርሃት የለም፥ ፍርሃት ቅጣት አለውና፤ የሚፈራም ሰው ፍቅሩ ፍጹም አይደለም።

verses.en: We love him, because he first loved us.
verses.fr: Pour nous, nous l''aimons, parce qu''il nous a aimés le premier.
verses.am: እርሱ አስቀድሞ ወዶናልና እኛ እንወደዋለን።

verses.en: If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un dit: J''aime Dieu, et qu''il haïsse son frère, c''est un menteur; car celui qui n''aime pas son frère qu''il voit, comment peut-il aimer Dieu qu''il ne voit pas?
verses.am: ማንም። እግዚአብሔርን እወዳለሁ እያለ ወንድሙን ቢጠላ ሐሰተኛ ነው፤ ያየውን ወንድሙን የማይወድ ያላየውን እግዚአብሔርን ሊወደው እንዴት ይችላል?

verses.en: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth God love his brother also.
verses.fr: Et nous avons de lui ce commandement: que celui qui aime Dieu aime aussi son frère.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም የሚወድ ወንድሙን ደግሞ እንዲወድ ይህች ትእዛዝ ከእርሱ አለችን።

verses.en: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him.
verses.fr: Quiconque croit que Jésus est le Christ, est né de Dieu, et quiconque aime celui qui l''a engendré aime aussi celui qui est né de lui.
verses.am: ክርስቶስ ነው ብሎ በኢየሱስ የሚያምን ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ተወልዶአል፥ ወላጁንም የሚወድ ሁሉ ከእርሱ የተወለደውን ደግሞ ይወዳል።

verses.en: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments.
verses.fr: Nous connaissons que nous aimons les enfants de Dieu, lorsque nous aimons Dieu, et que nous pratiquons ses commandements.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ስንወድ ትእዛዛቱንም ስናደርግ የእግዚአብሔርን ልጆች እንድንወድ በዚህ እናውቃለን።

verses.en: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
verses.fr: Car l''amour de Dieu consiste à garder ses commandements. Et ses commandements ne sont pas pénibles,
verses.am: ትእዛዛቱን ልንጠብቅ የእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር ይህ ነውና፤ ትእዛዛቱም ከባዶች አይደሉም።

verses.en: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world: and this is the victory that overcometh the world, even our faith.
verses.fr: parce que tout ce qui est né de Dieu triomphe du monde; et la victoire qui triomphe du monde, c''est notre foi.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር የተወለደ ሁሉ ዓለምን ያሸንፋልና፤ ዓለምንም የሚያሸንፈው እምነታችን ነው።

verses.en: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?
verses.fr: Qui est celui qui a triomphé du monde, sinon celui qui croit que Jésus est le Fils de Dieu?
verses.am: ኢየሱስም የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ እንደ ሆነ ከሚያምን በቀር ዓለምን የሚያሸንፍ ማን ነው?

verses.en: This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.
verses.fr: C''est lui, Jésus-Christ, qui est venu avec de l''eau et du sang; non avec l''eau seulement, mais avec l''eau et avec le sang; et c''est l''Esprit qui rend témoignage, parce que l''Esprit est la vérité.
verses.am: በውኃና በደም የመጣ ይህ ነው እርሱም ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ፤ በውኃውና በደሙ እንጂ በውኃው ብቻ አይደለም።

verses.en: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost: and these three are one.
verses.fr: Car il y en a trois qui rendent témoignage:
verses.am: መንፈስም እውነት ነውና የሚመሰክረው መንፈስ ነው።

verses.en: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
verses.fr: l''Esprit, l''eau et le sang, et les trois sont d''accord.
verses.am: የሚመሰክሩት መንፈሱና ውኃው ደሙም ሦስት ናቸውና፤ ሦስቱም በአንድ ይስማማሉ።

verses.en: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.
verses.fr: Si nous recevons le témoignage des hommes, le témoignage de Dieu est plus grand; car le témoignage de Dieu consiste en ce qu''il a rendu témoignage à son Fils.
verses.am: የሰውን ምስክር ብንቀበል የእግዚአብሔር ምስክር ከእርሱ ይልቅ ይበልጣል፤ ስለ ልጁ የመሰከረው የእግዚአብሔር ምስክር ይህ ነውና።

verses.en: He that believeth on the Son of God hath the witness in himself: he that believeth not God hath made him a liar; because he believeth not the record that God gave of his Son.
verses.fr: Celui qui croit au Fils de Dieu a ce témoignage en lui-même; celui qui ne croit pas Dieu le fait menteur, puisqu''il ne croit pas au témoignage que Dieu a rendu à son Fils.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ የሚያምን በነፍሱ ምስክር አለው፤ በእግዚአብሔር የማያምን እግዚአብሔር ስለ ልጁ የመሰከረውን ምስክር ስላላመነ ሐሰተኛ አድርጎታል።

verses.en: And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.fr: Et voici ce témoignage, c''est que Dieu nous a donné la vie éternelle, et que cette vie est dans son Fils.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የዘላለምን ሕይወት እንደ ሰጠን ይህም ሕይወት በልጁ እንዳለ ምስክሩ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
verses.fr: Celui qui a le Fils a la vie; celui qui n''a pas le Fils de Dieu n''a pas la vie.
verses.am: ልጁ ያለው ሕይወት አለው፤ የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ የሌለው ሕይወት የለውም።

verses.en: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that ye may know that ye have eternal life, and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God.
verses.fr: Je vous ai écrit ces choses, afin que vous sachiez que vous avez la vie éternelle, vous qui croyez au nom du Fils de Dieu.
verses.am: የዘላለም ሕይወት እንዳላችሁ ታውቁ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ስም ለምታምኑ ይህን ጽፌላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us:
verses.fr: Nous avons auprès de lui cette assurance, que si nous demandons quelque chose selon sa volonté, il nous écoute.
verses.am: በእርሱ ዘንድ ያለን ድፍረት ይህ ነው፤ እንደ ፈቃዱ አንዳች ብንለምን ይሰማናል።

verses.en: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
verses.fr: Et si nous savons qu''il nous écoute, quelque chose que nous demandions, nous savons que nous possédons la chose que nous lui avons demandée.
verses.am: የምንለምነውንም ሁሉ እንዲሰማልን ብናውቅ ከእርሱ የለመነውን ልመና እንደ ተቀበልን እናውቃለን።

verses.en: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un voit son frère commettre un péché qui ne mène point à la mort, qu''il prie, et Dieu donnera la vie à ce frère, il la donnera à ceux qui commettent un péché qui ne mène point à la mort. Il y a un péché qui mène à la mort; ce n''est pas pour ce péché-là que je dis de prier.
verses.am: ማንም ወንድሙን ሞት የማይገባውን ኃጢአት ሲያደርግ ቢያየው ይለምን፥ ሞትም የማይገባውን ኃጢአት ላደረጉት ሕይወት ይሰጥለታል። ሞት የሚገባው ኃጢአት አለ፤ ስለዚያ እንዲጠይቅ አልልም።

verses.en: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
verses.fr: Toute iniquité est un péché, et il y a tel péché qui ne mène pas à la mort.
verses.am: ዓመፃ ሁሉ ኃጢአት ነው፥ ሞትም የማይገባው ኃጢአት አለ።

verses.en: We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself, and that wicked one toucheth him not.
verses.fr: Nous savons que quiconque est né de Dieu ne pèche point; mais celui qui est né de Dieu se garde lui-même, et le malin ne le touche pas.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር የተወለደ ሁሉ ኃጢአትን እንዳያደርግ፥ ነገር ግን ከእግዚአብሔር የተወለደው ራሱን እንዲጠብቅ ክፉውም እንዳይነካው እናውቃለን።

verses.en: And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lieth in wickedness.
verses.fr: Nous savons que nous sommes de Dieu, et que le monde entier est sous la puissance du malin.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንን ዓለምም በሞላው በክፉው እንደ ተያዘ እናውቃለን።

verses.en: And we know that the Son of God is come, and hath given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.
verses.fr: Nous savons aussi que le Fils de Dieu est venu, et qu''il nous a donné l''intelligence pour connaître le Véritable; et nous sommes dans le Véritable, en son Fils Jésus-Christ. C''est lui qui est le Dieu véritable, et la vie éternelle.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ልጅ እንደ መጣ፥ እውነተኛም የሆነውን እናውቅ ዘንድ ልቡናን እንደ ሰጠን እናውቃለን፤ እውነተኛም በሆነው በእርሱ አለን፥ እርሱም ልጁ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ነው። እርሱ እውነተኛ አምላክና የዘላለም ሕይወት ነው።

verses.en: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
verses.fr: Petits enfants, gardez-vous des idoles.
verses.am: ልጆች ሆይ፥ ከጣዖታት ራሳችሁን ጠብቁ።
